:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- set_prolog_flag(double_quotes, string).

read_ints(N, L) :-
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, C),
    C \= end_of_file,
    ( C == [] -> read_ints(N, L) ; true ),
    ( var(C) -> true ; true ),
    parse_ints(C, L0),
    length(L0, N),
    L = L0.

parse_ints(C, L) :-
    phrase(ints(L), C).

ints([X|T]) --> ws, integer(X), ints(T).

ws --> [C], { C == 32 ; C == 9 ; C == 10 ; C == 13 }, !, ws.
ws --> [].

integer(I) --> digits(D), { number_codes(I, D) }, ( sign before? ).

:- module(main, [main/0]).

main :-
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, Line1),
    ( Line1 == end_of_file -> true ;
      parse_ints(Line1, [N]),
      read_line_to_codes(user_input, Line2),
      ( Line2 == end_of_file -> L = [] ; parse_ints(Line2, L) ),
      ( length(L, N) -> true ; collect_more(N, L, A) ),
      max_subarray(A, Best),
      format("~d~n", [Best]) ).

collect_more(N, L, A) :-
    append(L, _, A),
    length(A, N),
    read_all_rest(A).

read_all_rest(A) :-
    read_all_rest([], A).

read_all_rest(Acc, A) :-
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, C),
    ( C == end_of_file -> A = Acc ;
      parse_ints(C, L),
      append(Acc, L, Acc2),
      read_all_rest(Acc2, A) ).

parse_ints(C, L) :- phrase(int_list(L), C).

int_list([]) --> [].
int_list([X|T]) --> ws, int(X), int_list(T).

ws --> [C], { memberchk(C, " \t\r\n") }, ws.
ws --> [].

int(X) --> "-", digits(D), { number_codes(N, D), X is -N }, !.
int(X) --> digits(D), { number_codes(X, D) }, !.

digits([D|T]) --> [C], { C >= 0'0, C =< 0'9, D = C }, !, digits(T).
digits([]) --> [].

max_subarray([F|Rest], Best) :-
    max_sub(Rest, F, F, Best).
max_sub([], _, Best, Best).
max_sub([X|T], Cur, B0, Best) :-
    C1 is max(X, Cur + X),
    B1 is max(B0, C1),
    max_sub(T, C1, B1, Best).
